faq.q: Why does disappointment feel so heavy?
faq.a: You had a picture in your head of something lovely, and it was taken away. Your body feels that loss, so you may feel heavy, tired or teary for a while.
asks: Why do I feel so let down?

faq.q: Is it okay to feel cross when plans change?
faq.a: Yes. Feeling cross or sad is normal when something you wanted does not happen. You can say "I am really disappointed" instead of taking it out on others.
asks: Why do I get angry when plans are cancelled?

faq.q: How do I feel better when I am disappointed?
faq.a: Name the feeling, let yourself feel it for a bit, talk to someone, then think of a Plan B or a new date to look forward to.

faq.q: What if I am disappointed in myself?
faq.a: Be as kind to yourself as you would be to a friend. You tried, and that matters. Think about what you learned and what you might try next time.

faq.q: What if I disappoint someone else?
faq.a: Everyone lets others down sometimes. Say sorry if you need to, talk about it, and try to put things right. People who love you still love you.

facts: The word "disappoint" comes from an old French word that meant to remove someone from their appointed job.
Psychologists use the word resilience for the ability to cope with setbacks and bounce back.
